entries.name: NativeWindow
entries.description: A direct Expo UI Jetpack Compose host for application-owned native windows.

entries.name: normalizeBubbleId
entries.description:
Normalizes a JavaScript bubble ID before it is sent to the native overlay service.

Unsupported characters become `-`, repeated dashes collapse, and empty values use
`DEFAULT_BUBBLE_ID`.

entries.name: normalizeOverlaySharedValueKey
entries.description:
Normalizes a shared value key before it is read from or written to native state.

Unsupported characters become `-`, repeated dashes collapse, and empty values use
`DEFAULT_OVERLAY_SHARED_VALUE_KEY`.

entries.name: openApp

entries.name: setBubbleRenderer
entries.description:
Registers a global renderer used by bubbles without a per-bubble override.
